title: Measurement Scale Factor
definition: A measurement scale factor is the multiplier by which stored data values are multiplied after reading to recover the physical values of a variable.[^1] In the netCDF attribute convention the multiplication is applied after the data are read, and when an offset is also present the data are scaled first and the offset added afterwards.[^1][^2] The convention applies to packed storage, where the stored variable is typically a narrow integer type and the unpacked values are floating point.[^1]
